verdict.rationale: Deel documents an official MCP server that exposes payroll data to Claude, ChatGPT, or custom agents, with tools mapped to Deel API operations that return structured JSON. That gives an agent a first-party way to pull payroll data. However, nothing in the evidence mentions payroll journal entries, GL-formatted exports, or accounting or ledger reconciliation, so only the data-access half of the story is supported, and only thinly. Missing for 10: documented payroll journal or GL export endpoints, a named MCP tool for payroll reports, accounting or ledger integration or a reconciliation workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
